title: optimize-nccl-overlap-tp-kernels-and-continuous-batching
author: Priya Shah
description: Improve multi-GPU tensor-parallel serving performance by tuning NCCL collectives and stream scheduling, optimizing kernel launch paths, and hardening continuous batching/KV cache interactions. This PR introduces deterministic stream-priority assignments for collective and compute streams, enables async NCCL collectives where safe, adds a lightweight kernel cache for short-lived pointwise kernels, and updates the continuous-batching scheduler to avoid KV-cache thrashing under bursty traffic. Benchmarking on internal canary shows up to 18% throughput improvement for long-context TP models and 15-25% p99 token latency reduction across several sequence-length distributions. Includes regression tests, perf harness updates, and rollout gating to Dedicated clusters for gradual deployment.
commits: Tune: set per-device stream priorities and explicit stream assignment for TP collectives
Perf: enable NCCL asynchronous collectives with safety checks and fallback to blocking
Kernel: add micro-kernel cache for elementwise and small-matmul kernels
Scheduler: adaptive batching window + KV-cache-aware batching policy
Tests: add integration and perf tests; update canary configs
files_changed: runtime/tensor_parallel/nccl_scheduler.cpp - implement stream priority mapping and enqueue logic
runtime/kernels/kernel_cache.h/.cpp - small kernel cache and LRU eviction
runtime/scheduler/continuous_batcher.cpp - batching window adaption and kv-cache hints
runtime/kv_cache/kv_shard_manager.cpp - add idle shard eviction hook
review_thread: Daniel Kim: Can you add more detail on safety checks when async NCCL is enabled? If a stream fallback occurs, will we hit deadlocks?

Priya Shah: Async NCCL is gated behind a device capability check and a per-model flag. We add a global watchdog that falls back to blocking collectives if a timeout or inconsistent communicator state is detected. No deadlocks were observed in our stress runs; added tests to validate fallback path.
Miguel Alvarez: The kernel cache sounds useful but I'm worried about memory blowup on large models. How do we bound the cache?

Priya Shah: Kernel cache is sharded by device and limited by bytes; default is 64MB/device and it's configurable via RUNTIME_KERNEL_CACHE_MAX_BYTES. We evict LRU entries on pressure and don't cache kernels above a size threshold. Added metrics for cache size and eviction rate.
Sofia Chen: Continuous batching change could interact badly with KV cache and cold starts; can we avoid thrashing when a large model with many shards warms up?

Priya Shah: Batcher now consults KV-shard-hotness signal from kv_shard_manager. During warmup we bias towards smaller batches and prefer requests that hit warmed shards. Also added a short grace period after scale events to avoid oscillatory behavior. See tests/integration/tp_overlap_perf_test.py for simulated warmup scenarios.
Daniel Kim: CI flaky on first run (timeout in tp_overlap_perf_test), reran and passed. Approving after CI green and perf numbers validated on canary.
Miguel Alvarez: Approved — looks safe for gradual rollout.
Sofia Chen: Approved with docs note added.
release_notes: Performance: improved multi-GPU tensor-parallel throughput and latency by tuning NCCL collectives and improving stream/kernel scheduling; added kernel cache and KV-cache-aware continuous batching. Rollout: gated gradual rollout to Dedicated clusters. Config knobs: RUNTIME_NCCL_ASYNC_ENABLED, RUNTIME_KERNEL_CACHE_MAX_BYTES, RUNTIME_BATCHER_KV_HOTNESS_THRESHOLD.
perf_results_summary: Canary (8xA100, TP=8): 18% throughput increase for long-context chat model, p50 token latency ~5% down, p95 ~12% down, p99 ~20% down. Memory overhead: +30MB/device kernel cache default. Regression tests: no quality regressions observed on representative eval prompts.
notes_for_ops: Default rollout is off for Hosted; enabled on Dedicated via feature flag rollout config. Operations should watch metrics: tp_nccl_fallback_count, kernel_cache_evictions, batcher_kv_hotness_misses, serving_p99_token_latency. If NCCL fallback spikes, disable RUNTIME_NCCL_ASYNC_ENABLED and open ENG-ops ticket.
